acceptance_tests.name: sarf eval runner all-bank mode
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: exit 0 with the terminal line SARF EVAL RUNNER PASS

acceptance_tests.name: sarf eval runner unit suite
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: unittest OK (all mutation/negative gates still catch a broken consumer)

acceptance_tests.name: candidate/public boundary
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: the report line reads 'candidate/projector/public boundary: verified'

adversarial.expectation: a voweled surface must not be collapsed to a single certain reading in order to match a class

positive.expectation: keeps both competing readings and stays homograph_split

candidate_population.selection_rule: exactly the rows listed in the runner's evidence_class_mismatch_rows metric (MCL-002, MCL-005), in file order

commands.expect: exit 0; evidence_class_agreement reported with evidence_class_mismatch_rows [MCL-002, MCL-005] and the property listed as uncovered
SARF EVAL RUNNER PASS with the property moved to covered, or an updated floor plus a recorded reason

defeaters: Voweling narrows a reading, it does not certify one; a voweled surface may still be a homograph.
A lone single-letter peel is almost always a radical and must stay low-confidence.
A class that is right for the top-ranked candidate may be wrong for the rest of the lattice.
definition_of_done: each of the two divergent rows is closed or explicitly recorded as a procedure-level open question
evidence_class_agreement is either promoted to a covered property with per-row agreement, or stays uncovered with its floor documented as a regression guard only
the ambiguity guarantee and the never-auto_safe guarantee are unchanged

conditions: the procedure does not settle the class for a row
closing the gap would require dropping a competing candidate
escalation_trigger.route: stop and record the divergence in the contract not_enforced_properties list; hand back to the sarf lane owner

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If the procedure does not settle a class, leave the engine as it is and record the divergence; never widen the closed vocabulary to make a row agree.
evidence_policy.statement: Evidence is the procedure document and the closed evidence-class vocabulary in the schema only.

expected_outputs.description: Evidence-class assignment reconciled with the procedure, with the ambiguity guarantee intact.
Updated measured pin and unenforced list for the bank.

guards: Only the METHOD transfers: this packet fixes procedure, guards and acceptance tests and never pre-writes a linguistic conclusion for the executor to copy.
Every candidate keeps score AND rank and no boolean correct flag is ever introduced.
Arbitrary and corpus-backed tokens are never auto_safe.
The four sarf@2.1-@2.4 increments stay CANDIDATE and may not be cited as released authority.

This packet authorizes NO certification, NO rule promotion and NO public output: it may extend the runner, its tests, the shared harness wiring and the golden-command documentation, while the eval banks, the rule store, the skill registries, the projector ledger and the certification store stay immutable.
Re-run the candidate/projector/public boundary check with the full run (a targeted --bank run renders it not_checked and never claims it verified).

non_deployment.statement: Nothing in this packet mutates a live surface, an entry store or a whitelist. All outputs are candidate-mode repository artifacts; certification stays with the canonical certifier.

out_of_scope: Ambiguity preservation outranks class agreement: never drop a candidate to make a class match.
root, lemma and pattern stay null unless a real certifier supplies them.
Do not touch the certification store, entry data or projectors.
scope.summary: tools/run_sarf_evals.py runs the real lattice over sarf/evals/morphology-candidate-lattice.jsonl and reports evidence_class agreement per row: MCL-002 and MCL-005 disagree with the engine. The property `evidence_class_agreement` is declared UNCOVERED in property_coverage and its floor is a regression guard, never a released linguistic rule. Decide which side is right and close the gap without collapsing any ambiguity.
